newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as Dow regains 6,000 mark.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as Dow regains 6,000 mark.

text.p: UK shares finished a disappointing week in a more upbeat mood as Wall Street finally looked like breaking a string of recent losses on Friday, traders said.

The re-emergence of bid speculation in the electricity industry also played a part and after an uncertain start which saw the FTSE 100 drop further below the 4,000 mark, UK shares finished 23 points higher at 4,022.4 with advancers leading decliners two to one.
After setting a new all-time high on Monday of 4,073.2. the FTSE 100 has struggled as four successive losses on Wall Street pulled it back below the 4,000 mark.
